continuity_scope: Pass limited to Steven Erikson's Gardens of the Moon, Tor edition ISBN 9781429926584, Book One only. Excludes the remaining Malazan Book of the Fallen novels, Esslemont works, prequels, novellas, RPG material, companion works, and adaptations.
coverage_rule: Eleven named individual dramatic characters with material agency in this one novel; armies, houses, peoples, gods-as-collectives, places, and artifacts remain terms rather than relationship endpoints.
omissions: Books Two through Ten and all other Malazan continuities.
Collective/institutional nodes, places, species, warrens, and artifacts.
uncertainties: Names, titles, and allegiances may be partial or deceptive within this volume.
Chapter locators are used because pagination differs across editions.
War violence, possession, trauma, and coercion need contextual treatment.
evidence_basis: Primary claims use the declared Tor printed witness and chapter loci; the official Macmillan record establishes edition and Book One context.

supports: Declared Tor edition, author, and Book One series context.
